useCase: 检测AI生成文本ures, 频域 篡改, and model-specific 伪影
mechanism: 应用 multi-level DWT decomposition and 分析 统计 properties of detail 系数 (LH, HL, HH sub-bands). AI生成的 images exhibit different energy 分布s and 系数 相关性s in 小波 domain.
accuracy: 高 - 85-92% for detecting GAN and diffusion model outputs
name: 小波分析
parameters: Wavelet: Daubechies-4, Levels: 3-5, Sub-bands: LH/HL/HH, Metrics: energy, 方差, kurtosis per sub-band
description: Decomposes the image using 小波 transforms to analyze frequency sub-bands. AI models leave characteristic 模式 in high-frequency 小波 系数.

references.title: Li, H. et al. (2018). Can Forensic Detectors Identify GAN Generated Images? APSIPA ASC.
Mallat, S. (1989). A Theory for Multiresolution Signal Decomposition. IEEE TPAMI.

strengths:
• Multi-scale frequency 分析
• High 准确度 for GAN and diffusion models
• Captures energy 分布 异常
• Well-established signal processing technique
limitations:
• Requires sufficient image 分辨率
• Heavy JPEG压缩 affects 小波 系数
• Computational cost increases with decomposition levels
• Performance varies 跨 different AI architectures
